description: Run before buying, accepting or recommending a token. Answers SAFE, CAUTION or AVOID with the exact reasons, from on-chain and market data. Checks what the token's issuer can do (mint, freeze, Token-2022 traps), verification, liquidity, who holds it and how old it is, and turns that into one verdict. Inputs: token: The token's address. network (optional): Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.02 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/token_safety.
name: token_safety
